name: Queen Hyoui
contribution: The wife and queen consort of King Jeongjo of Joseon.

checks.lead: Queen Hyoui (Korean: 효의왕후; Hanja: 孝懿王后; 25 December 1753 – 29 March 1821), of the Cheongpung Kim clan (청풍 김씨; 淸風 金氏), was the wife and queen consort of King Jeongjo of Joseon. In 1899, Emperor Gojong posthumously gave her the title of Hyoui, the Kind Empress (효의선황후; 孝懿宣皇后).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
